note: Skateboards (F-VEH-SKATES; LIVING_CITY CITY-098 to CITY-104). The owner, 2026-11-24, first asked for skates, then the same day had them made skateboards: the manual board is pushed along with one foot while W is held, the electric and Neon Boost boards are ridden standing still. Each kind: top speed (km/h, the owner's), how fast it gets there, how it glides and brakes, whether a foot pushes it, its size (metres: deck length and width, height of the deck top above the ground, wheelbase, track, wheel diameter; measured from look test 32) and colours (linear RGB 0-1, from look test 32, Tools/blender/skateboards_32.py). Prices come with the store (CITY-102, CITY-103). All but the top speeds are [ASSUMPTION]. turn_rate: how fast A and D turn the rider standing still (radians a second), slower at speed (divided by 1 + speed in m/s / 15); cam_follow: how fast the camera comes round behind. indoor_top_kmh: the limit inside buildings; mall_top_kmh: inside a mall (the owner, 2026-11-24: "allow 30 km/h inside the mall").
